description: An older woman with grey hair pulled back, wearing a long black dress with a high collar and a dark fringed shawl, stands at the edge of a dark wood-panelled doorway looking calmly toward a younger man. The man is in a dark, closely buttoned coat with brass buttons and holds a black top hat in one hand, standing in an open street-facing door with a bright street behind him. The interior has patterned wallpaper, gilt-framed pictures and a curtained window. The style is a dark oil-painting look with no visible text.
